description: Versioned Next-Rupee road risk model. Risk is computed from road-level evidence only; ward affordability, DLP status, social likes/forwards and engineer remarks never enter the risk score.
recommendation_reasoning: A_balanced keeps every factor visible and weights the two evidence-of-failure factors (open complaints, reopened repairs) equally with the two harm factors, so no single data source can dominate; the other three profiles are used only to prove stability.

factor_definitions.C: Open + In Progress complaints whose source GPS falls within complaint_radius_m of the road segment (nearest segment only). Observed only if at least one complaint of any status is within range.
factor_definitions.R: Count of work orders on the road recorded as reopened within 30 days. Observed only if the road has at least one work order.
factor_definitions.F: Sum over flood hotspots within hotspot_radius_m of years_flagged_last_5 x (1 - distance/radius). Always observed.
factor_definitions.A: Severity-weighted accidents (Fatal 5, Grievous 3, Minor 1) with a road-surface probable cause on the road_id. Always observed.
factor_definitions.V: Facilities whose ambulance_entry_road is the road: emergency hospital base + beds, school base + students (capped). Always observed.
factor_definitions.T: Weighted blend of winsorised peak-hour vehicles, congestion index, bus routes and two-wheeler share. Observed if a traffic row exists.
factor_definitions.D: Mean 30-day reopen-rate gap between the surface methods used on the road and the best surface method. Observed only if the road has surface work orders.

missing_value_rule: Missing factors are not zero-filled: risk = sum(w_f x norm_f) / sum(w_f) over observed factors; evidence_coverage_pct = 100 x sum(observed weights).
affordable_now_rule: Independent of risk rank: ward monsoon budget minus recorded ward spend >= candidate treatment estimate (rate card x assumed area). Evaluated only in NEW_BUDGET_CANDIDATE_LANE.

dlp_lane.allocation_note: New municipal repair allocation: defer pending DLP scope review.
dlp_lane.potential_spend_label: Potential new spend avoided if contractual coverage is confirmed
dlp_lane.caveat: DLP status is temporal/contextual evidence and does not prove contractual applicability or liability.
